comment: Screenshot spec. One entry per image. See screenshots/README.md.

shots.caption: The plugin screen at Tools > Email Check: status, settings, and the result log.
shots.alt: The Email Check screen in wp-admin with status, settings and a table of recent results.

shots.caption: The notice in wp-admin when a check fails, with a link to decode the error.
shots.alt: A red admin notice on the Dashboard: Email check failed, with the SMTP error and links.

shots.caption: The notice when scheduled checks have stopped running.
shots.alt: A yellow admin notice on the Dashboard: Email checks have stopped, with a WP-Cron note and links.

shots.caption: An alert in a chat app when a check fails, sent through the optional webhook.
shots.alt: A chat channel with two messages from Email Check: Email check failed on the site with SMTP Error: Could not authenticate, then Email check passed again.

shots.caption: Status and settings on the Email Check screen.
shots.alt: Last check passed, daily schedule, recipient field, schedule choice and a Slack webhook URL.

shots.caption: The result log: passing checks, and a failure with its SMTP error.
shots.alt: A table of recent results. Two rows failed with SMTP Error: Could not authenticate; the rest passed.

shots.caption: The notice when a check fails.
shots.alt: Admin notice: Email check failed, with the error text and links to the error page, the results and Dismiss.

shots.caption: The notice when scheduled checks have stopped.
shots.alt: Admin notice: Email checks have stopped, with a DISABLE_WP_CRON note and links.

shots.caption: Overview: the notice on the Dashboard when a check fails.
shots.alt: The WordPress Dashboard with a red notice: Email check failed, the SMTP error, and links to the error page, the results and Dismiss.

shots.caption: Overview: the result log with a failure and the recovery.
shots.alt: A table of recent results: daily checks passed, two failed with SMTP Error: Could not authenticate, then a manual check passed and daily checks passed again.

shots.caption: Overview: the webhook alert in a chat app, for a failure and the recovery.
shots.alt: A chat channel with two messages from Email Check: Email check failed on the site with SMTP Error: Could not authenticate, then Email check passed again.

shots.caption: Connect to nanoPost: what the site sends, before anything is sent.
shots.alt: The nanoPost section on the Email Check screen: what connecting adds, the list of data the site sends, a Connect to nanoPost button, and links to the terms, privacy and help.

shots.caption: A connected site: tests go to nanoPost.
shots.alt: The nanoPost section of a connected site: the address the tests go to, a link to the check in nanoPost, and a Disconnect button.

replace..nanopost-email-check-proof-status: Arrived at nanoPost: November 27, 2026 9:12 am. SPF: pass. DKIM: pass. DMARC: pass.

shots.caption: Proof of arrival after Send test now.
shots.alt: The proof of arrival box: the test email arrived at nanoPost, with SPF, DKIM and DMARC pass, and links to the check and to help.

shots.caption: The Email Canary area before it is on.
shots.alt: The Email Canary area: a short offer, the field Send alerts to with you@example.com, the button Turn on Email Canary, the text of what the site sends, and links to what is sent, the terms and the privacy policy.

shots.caption: Email Canary is on.
shots.alt: The Email Canary area: Email Canary is on, the last test arrived with SPF and DMARC passed and DKIM not signed, the next test is expected by a time, alerts go to you@example.com with a Change link, the webhook, and the button Turn Email Canary off.

shots.caption: Alerts are off until you confirm.
shots.alt: The Email Canary area: Alerts are OFF until you confirm, we sent an email to you@example.com, the time when the 24 hours end, and the Resend and Change controls.

shots.caption: A new alert address waits for its confirm.
shots.alt: The Email Canary area: alerts go to you@example.com, and the text Waiting for the confirm of new@example.com.

shots.caption: Email Canary is off.
shots.alt: The Email Canary area after a turn-off: Email Canary is off, the history is kept for 30 days, and the field Send alerts to with the button Turn on Email Canary.

shots.caption: Alerts do not reach the alert address.
shots.alt: The Email Canary area: alerts go to you@example.com, with the warning Email Canary: alerts do not reach you@example.com.

shots.caption: A test email that did not arrive.
shots.alt: The Email Canary area: the test email of a given time did not arrive; Email Check sent it, so it was probably lost or refused after that.

shots.caption: Recent tests, with the Email Check and Email Canary columns.
shots.alt: A table of recent tests: each row shows whether WordPress sent the test email and, for the newest ones, whether it arrived at nanoPost with its SPF, DKIM and DMARC labels.

shots.caption: The plugin screen with its two areas, Email Check and Email Canary.
shots.alt: The plugin screen: the Email Check area with the last test, how the site sends, the schedule and the Send test now button; the Email Canary area with its state; and the settings.
